description: Joins the channels of up to sixteen cables end to end into one long list, and puts a window of that list out on a polyphonic cable

inputs.text: One of the sixteen signals joined into the list, contributing all of its channels at the place its number gives; an empty jack contributes nothing and the list closes up
Sets how many channels the output carries, one at 0V and as many as the list holds at 10V, never more than sixteen
Sets which channel of the list the output starts from, the first at 0V and the last at 10V, wrapping round the end of the list

outputs.text: The window of the joined list, as a polyphonic cable

notes: the list holds up to 256 channels, sixteen from each jack, and only sixteen of them can leave at once; Width and Rotation choose which.
with no signal cables patched the output carries 0V on as many channels as Width sets, which is sixteen when Width is unpatched too.

inputs.16:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 10V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.17:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
